display_name: 困难样本直接恢复与盲干净保护组合
description: 固定源训练保护网络和困难样本恢复器，在另一组源模拟信道视图上作关联样本筛选；固定后 Phase1 全视图测试。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python GPU2 if idle, two CPU threads

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: float32 IQ [2,256]; source L_s/U_s paired clean and simulated post_sync residual channel
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX labels read in this fixed-model evaluation; parent curriculum used legitimate training L_s labels
data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 day3 IDs and 3921 RX8 day3 heldout using cache19; same physical IDs previously used for source gate selection cache20; no V
data.leo_config_ref: Source cache epoch19 fresh channel realization on previously used physical IDs; seven Phase1 simulated scenes

permissions.query_use: No target data until all source selection fixed; then seven-view predictions before truth; no Phase3
permissions.claim_scope: Single seed, source heldout and Phase1 development previously observed, no independent-blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source-selected IQ corruption gate and fixed curriculum parent checkpoint 1/2/4; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; no DURA
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: core.data checks physical IDs against Tri-SIG-TIME roles; parent commit exact
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Cache19 RX4/6 day3 pseudo targets + IQ, curriculum epochs 1/2/4 x alpha .25/.5 x gate thresholds .8/.9/.95/.99; prior 0.5% per-cell classification and IQ guards, >=10 impaired net gain; RX8 heldout excluded; IDs reused from cache20 gate selection

execution.launch_owner: Codex labeled curriculum and blind gate fixed source comparison
execution.gpu_policy: GPU2 only if idle; one worker, two CPU threads

dimensions: source per receiver and scene F pseudo agreement
source clean preservation and gate rate
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Goal six scenario accuracies versus clean ground SSL <=3 pp and also <=3% relative, clean protection, no blind claim.

rows.budget_ref: 7840 source selection IDs and 3921 heldout IDs; correlated source physical IDs on cache19
